race.comment: POISED (8) was a determined maiden winner last time out at Gilgandra. Has a wide gate to overcome but she should measure up again. AEROFOIL (2) was prominent at the turn but turned in a mediocre run last time out over 1206m at this track after a nice win the start prior. Will enjoy a drop in class so he is a major player. KEN'KER (1) is on a quick back-up after finishing eighth in better company eight days ago over 1000m at Taree. Suitably placed so expecting a better run this time. LITTLE PROPHET (5) was allowed to drift back from an outside draw last time but found the line strongly to finish fourth here. Solid top-three prospects. TICKLE MY TOSEN (4) returns and has been fitted with a trial here. Best form can threaten.
